msg: warning: Variable x is a dead store!
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: 30e053248da.c (Linux reiserfs). Dead store on 'x' at line 31 ('int x = *length'), presence condition True (all configs). When CONFIG_SECURITY=true: security_old_inode_init_security writes *len, so *length is valid; x is assigned but never used → simplification artifact (dead store is false). When CONFIG_SECURITY=false: security_old_inode_init_security returns 0 without writing *len, so *length is uninitialized — there IS a real bug (reading uninitialized value) but the alarm misidentifies it as a dead store rather than an uninitialized value read. The dead store alarm is a false positive in both configurations. The known vbdb bug (PULSE_UNINITIALIZED_VALUE on length when SECURITY=false) is classified separately in PRODUCT reports.
